articles.title: Trump Admin Boots Lebanese Diplomat Over Posts Praising Hezbollah's 1983 Marine Barracks Suicide Bombing
articles.description: The Trump administration has ordered Lebanese diplomat Ibrahim Charara to leave the United States over social media posts in which he praised Hezbollah's 1983 suicide bombing of U.S. Marine barracks in Beirut as "heroic resistance" against "American military occupation." The posts were first reported by the Washington Free Beacon.
